proof_body:
by
  intro X _ x y p
  exact ⟨⟨Path.Homotopy.transRefl p⟩, ⟨Path.Homotopy.reflTrans p⟩, ⟨(Path.Homotopy.reflTransSymm p).symm⟩, ⟨(Path.Homotopy.reflSymmTrans p).symm⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] (x y : X) (p : Path x y), (p.trans (Path.refl y)).Homotopic p ∧ ((Path.refl x).trans p).Homotopic p ∧ (p.trans p.symm).Homotopic (Path.refl x) ∧ (p.symm.trans p).Homotopic (Path.refl y)
